render_rollout_frames: render rollout frames from mujoco model and state array with specified framerate and camera
render_batch_rollouts: render multiple rollouts by passing a list of mujoco models and batched state array
render_with_spotlight: render rollout frames with a custom spotlight light position for improved visualization
render_custom_resolution: render rollout frames at custom width and height resolution with specified camera
render_with_visualization_geoms: render rollout frames showing visualization geoms using mujoco MjvOption
